about: Runner stages for common/deepseek_route.py run-stage. Case lists, estimates and the fidelity target live in config.template.json (same stage names). Paths come from --artifact-root / AUDITOR_ARTIFACTS_ROOT; nothing machine-specific is stored here. Every argv names its suites with -s (ADI defect D1).

defaults.fidelity: backbone-substituted: deepseek-flash (thinking disabled, T=0) replaces GPT-5.2 as the baseline ReAct agent; ADI has no auxiliary or judge model

DRY.description: Plumbing only: banking/user_task_15 ADI case 0 through the guard to Ollama qwen2.5:7b-instruct. Not a measurement.

estimate.requests: <= 8 (adapter ceiling, SDK retries 0); prior pipeline-agent smoke used 4 (NOTES.md section 5b)
estimate.tokens: about 10k-40k notional (UNVERIFIED; banking ground-truth proxy 5.0k-6.6k per episode)

S1.description: 3 authority ADI cases on DeepSeek: banking/user_task_15[0], slack/user_task_13[0], workspace/user_task_7[0]. Confirms DeepSeek accepts the LangChain wire and calibrates tokens per episode for S2.

estimate.requests: about 9-25 (UNVERIFIED; lab 4.06 requests per native slot, ADI ground truth 2-6 steps)
estimate.tokens: about 30k-66k (UNVERIFIED; lab native per-suite means 29,560; ADI ground-truth proxy x1.5 = 48k-64k input + about 2.5k output)

S1.compares_to: none (wire acceptance and cost calibration only)

S2.description: All 108 data_only_syntactic ADI cases, then all 96 benign user tasks, baseline ReAct agent on DeepSeek. Resume after a stop with: run-stage ... -- --traces-dir <previous out_dir>/adapter/traces

estimate.requests: about 830-1,510 (UNVERIFIED; lab 4.06 per native slot x 204; ADI ground-truth steps 1,006 x 1.5)
estimate.tokens: about 3.2M-7.7M (UNVERIFIED; lab native per-suite means 3,183,163; ADI ground-truth proxy x1.5 = 5.52M-7.36M input + about 0.28M output)
estimate.usd: about 1.06-2.55 at the 2026-09-30 snapshot (UNVERIFIED; cache hits charged as misses)

S2.compares_to: ADI paper (arXiv:2607.05120v1 Fig. 9-10, section 6.2.2, pp.12-13), baseline ReAct with GPT-5.2-2025-12-11: ADI ASR 49.1% (53/108), benign utility 86.5% (83/96). Backbone-substituted, so reported side by side without a pass band.
